Pricing is by number of children (settings.fee.countTiers). Card payments (payment.online) go through BURLINGTON MASJID's Stripe account: BISS has no account of its own, and card stays unavailable (families see only the office route) until a SuperAdmin links BISS to its parent with PATCH /api/admin/masjids/<biss>/forms-card-account and FORMS_PAYMENT_RETURN_ORIGINS lists the BISS site. Card payers always cover the card fee; office payers never do. The cleaning-Sunday question (section `cleaning`) draws its choices from the school calendar and requires exactly two: BEFORE switching the form on, turn the school_calendar capability on for the org and enter the 2026-27 school year (2026-10-11 to 2027-05-30) and its seven no-school Sundays — with no open Sundays the required question refuses every enrollment.

settings.intro:
Burlington Islamic Sunday School (BISS) meets every Sunday from 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM, starting October 11, 2026, at Burlington Masjid, 1908 S Mebane St.

Each class covers Arabic (Al-Qaida An-Nooraniyya), Qur'an memorization and Islamic Studies. Children are placed in their class by age.

Fees for the year: 1 child $100 · 2 children $170 · 3 children $250 · 4 children $300 · 5 or more children $350.

Pay by card online, or pay the school office by Zelle, Cash App, Venmo, cash or check. Card payments include the card processing fee and are processed by Burlington Masjid.

payment.officeInstructions: Send your payment by Zelle, Cash App or Venmo to (336) 567-6340 — Burlington Islamic Sunday School. Please put your family name in the note. You can also pay the school office in cash or by check.
